<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<base target="_top">
<style>
:root{--ink:#1d2125;--mut:#666d75;--line:#d9dcdf;--bg:#f6f5f1;--card:#fff;--y:#f5c400;--ok:#1f7a45;--bad:#b3261e;--wrn:#8a6d00}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;font:15px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
header{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:5px solid var(--y)}
header h1{margin:0;font-size:19px}
main{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px;display:grid;gap:16px}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
.stat{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--y);padding:10px 12px}
.stat b{display:block;font-size:26px}.stat span{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px}
section{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px}
h2{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:16px}
form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:12px}
label{display:grid;gap:4px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
input,select,textarea{font:inherit;padding:9px;border:1px solid #aab0b6;border-radius:3px;background:#fff;min-height:42px}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--y);outline-offset:1px}
.full{grid-column:1/-1}
button{font:inherit;font-weight:700;padding:11px 18px;border:0;background:var(--y);color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;border-radius:3px}
button:disabled{opacity:.6}
.info{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;font-weight:400}
.msg{padding:9px 12px;margin-top:10px;border-left:4px solid;display:none}
.msg.ok{display:block;border-color:var(--ok);background:#e8f4ec}.msg.err{display:block;border-color:var(--bad);background:#fbeae9}
.scroll{overflow-x:auto}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:560px}
th,td{text-align:left;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
th{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.b{padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.Beroperasi{background:#e8f4ec;color:var(--ok)}.Standby{background:#fff4cc;color:var(--wrn)}.Rusak{background:#fbeae9;color:var(--bad)}

.charts{display:grid;gap:16px}
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:16px}
.chead{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:4px}
.chead h2{margin:0}
.sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;margin:0 0 10px}
.seg{display:flex;border:1px solid #aab0b6;border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden}
.seg button{background:#fff;border-radius:0;padding:6px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;min-height:34px}
.seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.kpi{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:22px;margin:6px 0 12px}
.kpi div{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}.kpi b{display:block;font-size:20px;color:var(--ink)}
.line svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
.line text{font:11px system-ui,sans-serif;fill:#666d75}
.line .val{font-weight:700;fill:#1d2125;font-size:12px}
.bars{display:grid;gap:9px}
.brow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:78px 1fr;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.brow .n{font-weight:600;font-size:13px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.track{background:#eef0f1;height:26px;border-radius:3px;position:relative}
.fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;min-width:3px;transition:width .5s}
.track span{position:absolute;left:8px;top:0;line-height:26px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.fill.jam{background:#3a4650}.fill.bbm{background:var(--y)}
.empty{color:var(--mut);padding:14px 0}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.fill{transition:none}}

header{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 24px;align-items:center}
.tabs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
.tabs button{background:transparent;color:#fff;border:1px solid #555d65;padding:8px 14px;min-height:38px}
.tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--y);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--y)}
.pane{display:grid;gap:16px}.pane[hidden]{display:none}
.brow.wide{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:3px}
.hint{background:#fff8d6;border-left:4px solid var(--y);padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px}
.meter{display:inline-block;width:64px;height:8px;background:#eef0f1;border-radius:4px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px}
.meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--ink);border-radius:4px}
table.wide{min-width:820px}
.tag{background:#eef0f1;border-radius:10px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px}

button.alt{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.lbar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-end}
.rep h3{font-size:15px;margin:20px 0 8px;padding-bottom:4px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--y)}
.rhead{text-align:center;margin-bottom:14px}.rhead h2{font-size:20px;margin:0}.rhead div{color:var(--mut)}
.rep ul{margin:0;padding-left:18px}.rep li{margin:3px 0}
.sign{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:20px;margin-top:28px;text-align:center}
.sign div{padding-top:60px}.sign span{display:block;border-top:1px solid var(--ink);padding-top:4px;font-size:13px}
.tot td{font-weight:700;background:#faf9f4}

.fill.ok{background:var(--ok)}.fill.mid{background:var(--y)}.fill.low{background:var(--bad)}
.mark{position:absolute;top:-3px;bottom:-3px;width:2px;background:var(--ink)}
.legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);margin:0 0 8px}
.legend i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-2px}
.okc{color:var(--ok);font-weight:700}.lowc{color:var(--bad)}
@media print{
  header,.noprint{display:none!important}
  body{background:#fff;font-size:12px}
  .pane{display:none!important}#tabLaporan{display:block!important}
  main{padding:0;max-width:none}
  section.rep{border:0;padding:0}
  .stat{border:1px solid #999}
  table{min-width:0;font-size:11px}th,td{white-space:normal}
  .scroll{overflow:visible}
}
@media(max-width:600px){main{padding:10px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header><h1>Pemantau Pemakaian Alat Berat</h1>
  <nav class="tabs" id="tabs" role="tablist">
    <button type="button" role="tab" data-t="tabAlat" aria-selected="true">Pemakaian Alat</button>
    <button type="button" role="tab" data-t="tabLangsir" aria-selected="false">Langsir Galian (DT)</button>
    <button type="button" role="tab" data-t="tabGalian" aria-selected="false">Hasil Galian</button>
    <button type="button" role="tab" data-t="tabProd" aria-selected="false">Produktivitas</button>
    <button type="button" role="tab" data-t="tabLaporan" aria-selected="false">Laporan Harian</button>
  </nav></header>
<main>
<div class="pane" id="tabAlat">
  <div class="stats" id="stats"></div>

  <section class="line">
    <div class="chead">
      <h2>Total pemakaian BBM</h2>
      <div class="seg" id="rng" role="group" aria-label="Rentang waktu">
        <button type="button" data-d="7" aria-pressed="false">7 hari</button>
        <button type="button" data-d="14" aria-pressed="true">14 hari</button>
        <button type="button" data-d="30" aria-pressed="false">30 hari</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="sub">Total liter solar yang dipakai semua alat setiap hari.</p>
    <div class="kpi" id="kpi"></div>
    <div id="lineChart"></div>
  </section>

  <div class="cols">
    <section>
      <h2>Total jam kerja per alat</h2>
      <p class="sub">Alat dengan jam kerja terbanyak ada di paling atas.</p>
      <div class="bars" id="barJam"></div>
    </section>
    <section>
      <h2>Total BBM per alat</h2>
      <p class="sub">Alat dengan pemakaian BBM terbesar ada di paling atas.</p>
      <div class="bars" id="barBbm"></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section>
    <h2>Catat pemakaian alat</h2>
    <form id="f">
      <label>Tanggal<input type="date" name="tanggal" required></label>
      <label>Alat<select name="kode" id="kode" required></select></label>
      <label>Operator<input name="operator" required autocomplete="off"></label>
      <label>Lokasi / pekerjaan<input name="lokasi" autocomplete="off"></label>
      <label>HM awal<input type="number" step="0.1" name="hmAwal" id="hmAwal" required><span class="info" id="hint"></span></label>
      <label>HM akhir<input type="number" step="0.1" name="hmAkhir" id="hmAkhir" required><span class="info" id="jam">Jam kerja: 0</span></label>
      <label>BBM (liter)<input type="number" step="0.1" name="bbm" value="0"></label>
      <label>Status<select name="status"><option>Beroperasi</option><option>Standby</option><option>Rusak</option></select></label>
      <label class="full">Catatan hasil galian / langsir<textarea name="catatan" rows="2" placeholder="Contoh: material keras, area berlumpur, ada batu besar, akses hauling licin"></textarea></label>
      <div class="full"><button id="btn">Simpan data</button><div class="msg" id="msg"></div></div>
    </form>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>Rekap per alat</h2>
    <div class="scroll"><table id="rekap"></table></div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>Input terbaru</h2>
    <div class="scroll"><table id="log"></table></div>
  </section>
</div>

<div class="pane" id="tabLangsir" hidden>
  <div class="stats" id="gStats"></div>

  <section>
    <h2>Progres total langsiran bekas galian</h2>
    <div id="gProg"></div>
  </section>

  <div class="cols">
    <section>
      <h2>Volume langsir per DT</h2>
      <p class="sub">Total material galian (m&sup3;) yang sudah diangkut tiap Dump Truck.</p>
      <div class="bars" id="gBarVol"></div>
    </section>
    <section>
      <h2>Jumlah rit per DT</h2>
      <p class="sub">Berapa kali tiap DT bolak-balik mengangkut material.</p>
      <div class="bars" id="gBarRit"></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section>
    <h2>Rute langsir terbesar</h2>
    <p class="sub">Dari lokasi galian ke lokasi buang, diurutkan menurut volume.</p>
    <div class="bars" id="gBarRute"></div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>Catat langsir bekas galian</h2>
    <form id="g">
      <label>Tanggal<input type="date" name="tanggal" required></label>
      <label>Dump Truck<select name="kode" id="gDt" required></select></label>
      <label>Sopir<input name="sopir" required autocomplete="off"></label>
      <label>Excavator pemuat<select name="excavator" id="gExc" required></select></label>
      <label>Excavator bongkar muatan<select name="excavatorBongkar" id="gExcB"></select><span class="info">Alat di lokasi buang (opsional)</span></label>
      <label>Asal (lokasi galian)<input name="asal" list="dlAsal" required autocomplete="off" placeholder="mis. Pit A"></label>
      <label>Tujuan (lokasi buang)<input name="tujuan" list="dlTujuan" required autocomplete="off" placeholder="mis. Disposal 1"></label>
      <label>Material<select name="material"><option>Tanah</option><option>Batu</option><option>Lumpur</option><option>Campuran</option></select></label>
      <label>Jumlah rit<input type="number" min="1" step="1" name="rit" id="gRit" required></label>
      <label>Kapasitas per rit (m&sup3;)<input type="number" min="0.1" step="0.1" name="kapasitas" id="gKap" value="10" required></label>
      <label>Jarak angkut (km)<input type="number" min="0" step="0.1" name="jarak"><span class="info" id="gVol">Volume: 0 m&sup3;</span></label>
      <label class="full">Catatan<textarea name="catatan" rows="2"></textarea></label>
      <div class="full"><button id="gBtn">Simpan langsir</button><div class="msg" id="gMsg"></div></div>
    </form>
    <datalist id="dlAsal"></datalist><datalist id="dlTujuan"></datalist>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>Langsir terbaru</h2>
    <div class="scroll"><table id="gLog"></table></div>
  </section>
</div>

<div class="pane" id="tabGalian" hidden>
  <section>
    <div class="chead">
      <h2>Hasil galian per alat</h2>
      <div class="seg" id="gaRng" role="group" aria-label="Rentang waktu">
        <button type="button" data-d="7" aria-pressed="false">7 hari</button>
        <button type="button" data-d="14" aria-pressed="true">14 hari</button>
        <button type="button" data-d="30" aria-pressed="false">30 hari</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="sub">Volume material yang digali tiap excavator per hari dibanding target. Data diambil dari catatan langsir (kolom excavator pemuat). Target periode dihitung dari hari yang ada catatan langsir.</p>
    <div class="stats" id="gaStats"></div>
    <div class="hint" id="gaInfo" style="margin-top:12px">Memuat data...</div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>Progres total volume galian</h2>
    <div id="gaProg"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="line">
    <h2>Volume galian harian vs target</h2>
    <div class="legend">
      <span><i style="background:#1f7a45"></i>Target tercapai</span>
      <span><i style="background:#f5c400"></i>75-99%</span>
      <span><i style="background:#b3261e"></i>&lt; 75%</span>
      <span>- - - Target harian</span>
    </div>
    <div id="gaChart"></div>
  </section>

  <div class="cols">
    <section>
      <h2>Capaian per excavator</h2>
      <p class="sub">Garis hitam pada batang = target (100%).</p>
      <div class="bars" id="gaBarCapai"></div>
    </section>
    <section>
      <h2>Atur target galian</h2>
      <p class="sub">Target volume galian per hari untuk satu excavator. Tersimpan di sheet Alat kolom E.</p>
      <form id="gaForm">
        <label>Excavator<select name="kode" id="gaKode" required></select></label>
        <label>Target (m&sup3;/hari)<input type="number" min="1" step="1" id="gaTarget" required></label>
        <div class="full"><button id="gaBtn">Simpan target</button><div class="msg" id="gaMsg"></div></div>
      </form>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section>
    <h2>Rekap per excavator</h2>
    <div class="scroll"><table class="wide" id="gaRekap"></table></div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>Rincian hasil galian per hari</h2>
    <p class="sub">Volume galian (m&sup3;) tiap excavator. Hijau = mencapai target alat tersebut, merah = di bawah target.</p>
    <div class="scroll"><table class="wide" id="gaHarian"></table></div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <div class="chead">
      <h2>Rekap hasil galian mingguan dan bulanan</h2>
      <div class="seg" id="gaRekapMode" role="group" aria-label="Jenis rekap">
        <button type="button" data-mode="minggu" aria-pressed="true">Mingguan</button>
        <button type="button" data-mode="bulan" aria-pressed="false">Bulanan</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="sub">Rekap berdasarkan seluruh histori transaksi langsir. Target dihitung dari jumlah hari yang memiliki catatan langsir.</p>
    <div class="scroll"><table class="wide" id="gaRekapPeriode"></table></div>
  </section>
</div>

<div class="pane" id="tabProd" hidden>
  <section>
    <div class="chead">
      <h2>Produktivitas alat berat</h2>
      <div class="seg" id="pRng" role="group" aria-label="Periode">
        <button type="button" data-d="7" aria-pressed="false">7 hari</button>
        <button type="button" data-d="30" aria-pressed="true">30 hari</button>
        <button type="button" data-d="0" aria-pressed="false">Semua</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="sub">Seberapa banyak pekerjaan yang dihasilkan alat dibanding jam dan BBM yang dipakai.</p>
    <div class="stats" id="pStats"></div>
    <div class="hint" id="pInfo" style="margin-top:12px">Memuat data...</div>
  </section>

  <div class="cols">
    <section>
      <h2>Produktivitas Dump Truck</h2>
      <p class="sub">Volume langsir per jam kerja (m&sup3;/jam). Makin panjang makin produktif.</p>
      <div class="bars" id="pBarDT"></div>
    </section>
    <section>
      <h2>Produktivitas Excavator</h2>
      <p class="sub">Volume material yang dimuat per jam kerja (m&sup3;/jam).</p>
      <div class="bars" id="pBarExc"></div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section>
    <h2>Utilisasi alat</h2>
    <p class="sub">Jam kerja dibanding target <span id="pTarget">8</span> jam per hari yang dicatat.</p>
    <div class="bars" id="pBarUtil"></div>
  </section>

  <section>
    <h2>Rapor per alat</h2>
    <div class="scroll"><table class="wide" id="pTabel"></table></div>
    <p class="sub" style="margin-top:10px">Utilisasi: Baik &ge; 75%, Cukup 50-74%, Rendah &lt; 50%. Ketersediaan = persentase hari tercatat alat tidak berstatus Rusak. L/m&sup3; = liter BBM per m&sup3; material.</p>
  </section>
</div>

<div class="pane" id="tabLaporan" hidden>
  <section class="noprint">
    <div class="chead">
      <h2>Laporan harian</h2>
      <div class="lbar">
        <label>Tanggal laporan<input type="date" id="lTgl"></label>
        <button type="button" id="lWa">Salin untuk WhatsApp</button>
        <button type="button" id="lPrint" class="alt">Cetak / Simpan PDF</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="sub">Rekap otomatis dari data pemakaian alat dan langsir pada tanggal yang dipilih.</p>
    <div class="msg" id="lMsg"></div>
    <textarea id="lBox" readonly rows="10" hidden style="width:100%;margin-top:8px"></textarea>
  </section>
  <section class="rep" id="lKertas"><div class="empty">Memuat laporan...</div></section>
</div>
</main>

<script>
let D = null;
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"]/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const f = $('f');
f.tanggal.value = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');

function render(d) {
  D = d;
  renderCharts();
  renderLangsir();
  const s = d.ringkas;
  $('stats').innerHTML = [
    [s.alatBeroperasi, 'Alat beroperasi hari ini'], [s.jamHariIni, 'Jam kerja hari ini'],
    [s.bbmHariIni + ' L', 'BBM hari ini'], [s.alatRusak, 'Alat rusak']
  ].map(x => `<div class="stat"><b>${x[0]}</b><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');

  const cur = $('kode').value;
  $('kode').innerHTML = d.alat.map(a => `<option value="${esc(a.kode)}">${esc(a.kode)} - ${esc(a.nama)}</option>`).join('');
  if (cur) $('kode').value = cur;
  hint();

  $('rekap').innerHTML = '<tr><th>Alat</th><th>HM terakhir</th><th>Total jam</th><th>Total BBM (L)</th><th>L/jam</th><th>Status</th></tr>' +
    d.rekap.map(r => `<tr><td>${esc(r.kode)} - ${esc(r.nama)}</td><td>${r.hmTerakhir}</td><td>${r.jam.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${r.bbm.toFixed(1)}</td><td>${r.lPerJam}</td><td><span class="b ${esc(r.status)}">${esc(r.status)}</span></td></tr>`).join('');

  $('log').innerHTML = d.terbaru.length
    ? '<tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Alat</th><th>Operator</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Jam</th><th>BBM</th><th>Status</th></tr>' +
      d.terbaru.map(l => `<tr><td>${esc(l.tanggal)}</td><td>${esc(l.kode)}</td><td>${esc(l.operator)}</td><td>${esc(l.lokasi)}</td><td>${l.jam}</td><td>${l.bbm}</td><td><span class="b ${esc(l.status)}">${esc(l.status)}</span></td></tr>`).join('')
    : '<tr><td>Belum ada data. Isi formulir di atas untuk mulai mencatat.</td></tr>';
}


const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });
let RANGE = 14;

function tgl(s) { const [y, m, d] = s.split('-'); return d + '/' + m; }

function renderLine() {
  const data = D.harian.slice(-RANGE);
  const total = data.reduce((t, x) => t + x.bbm, 0);
  const aktif = data.filter(x => x.bbm > 0).length;
  const top = data.reduce((a, b) => b.bbm > a.bbm ? b : a, data[0]);
  $('kpi').innerHTML =
    `<div><b>${nf.format(total)} L</b>Total ${RANGE} hari</div>` +
    `<div><b>${nf.format(aktif ? total / aktif : 0)} L</b>Rata-rata per hari kerja</div>` +
    `<div><b>${top.bbm ? nf.format(top.bbm) + ' L' : '-'}</b>Tertinggi${top.bbm ? ' (' + tgl(top.tanggal) + ')' : ''}</div>`;
  if (!total) { $('lineChart').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Belum ada data BBM pada rentang ini.</div>'; return; }

  const W = 700, H = 250, L = 44, R = 14, T = 22, B = 28, iw = W - L - R, ih = H - T - B;
  const rawMax = Math.max(...data.map(x => x.bbm));
  const step = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(rawMax / 4 || 1)));
  const unit = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(m => m * step).find(u => u * 4 >= rawMax) || step * 10;
  const max = unit * 4;
  const X = i => L + (data.length === 1 ? iw / 2 : i * iw / (data.length - 1));
  const Y = v => T + ih - v / max * ih;
  let g = '';
  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
    const y = Y(unit * i);
    g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="#e3e5e7"/><text x="${L - 6}" y="${y + 4}" text-anchor="end">${nf.format(unit * i)}</text>`;
  }
  const pts = data.map((x, i) => [X(i), Y(x.bbm)]);
  const path = pts.map((p, i) => (i ? 'L' : 'M') + p[0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + p[1].toFixed(1)).join(' ');
  const area = path + ` L${pts[pts.length - 1][0]} ${T + ih} L${pts[0][0]} ${T + ih} Z`;
  const every = Math.ceil(data.length / 7);
  const xl = data.map((x, i) => (i % every === 0 || i === data.length - 1) ? `<text x="${X(i)}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle">${tgl(x.tanggal)}</text>` : '').join('');
  const dots = data.map((x, i) => `<circle cx="${pts[i][0]}" cy="${pts[i][1]}" r="${x === top ? 6 : 4}" fill="${x === top ? '#1d2125' : '#f5c400'}" stroke="#1d2125" stroke-width="2"><title>${tgl(x.tanggal)}: ${nf.format(x.bbm)} L BBM, ${nf.format(x.jam)} jam kerja</title></circle>`).join('');
  const tp = pts[data.indexOf(top)];
  $('lineChart').innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Grafik total pemakaian BBM harian">
    ${g}<path d="${area}" fill="#f5c400" opacity=".28"/><path d="${path}" fill="none" stroke="#1d2125" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    ${dots}<text class="val" x="${tp[0]}" y="${tp[1] - 12}" text-anchor="middle">${nf.format(top.bbm)} L</text>${xl}
    <text x="${L}" y="12">Liter</text></svg>`;
}

function renderBars(id, rows, key, cls, unit, lab) {
  rows = rows.filter(r => r[key] > 0).sort((a, b) => b[key] - a[key]);
  if (!rows.length) { $(id).innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Belum ada data. Simpan input pertama untuk melihat grafik.</div>'; return; }
  const max = rows[0][key];
  $(id).innerHTML = rows.map(r => { const w = (r[key] / max * 78).toFixed(1); return `<div class="brow${lab ? ' wide' : ''}"><div class="n" title="${esc(r.nama || r[lab || 'kode'])}">${esc(r[lab || 'kode'])}</div>
    <div class="track"><div class="fill ${cls}" style="width:${w}%"></div><span style="left:calc(${w}% + 8px)">${nf.format(r[key])} ${unit}</span></div></div>`; }).join('');
}

function renderCharts() { renderLine(); renderBars('barJam', D.rekap, 'jam', 'jam', 'jam'); renderBars('barBbm', D.rekap, 'bbm', 'bbm', 'L'); }

$('rng').onclick = e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
  RANGE = +b.dataset.d;
  [...$('rng').children].forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === b));
  renderLine();
};

function fillSel(id, list) {
  const cur = $(id).value;
  $(id).innerHTML = list.map(a => `<option value="${esc(a.kode)}">${esc(a.kode)} - ${esc(a.nama)}</option>`).join('');
  if (cur) $(id).value = cur;
}
function renderLangsir() {
  const g = D.langsir, s = g.ringkas;
  $('gStats').innerHTML = [[nf.format(s.ritHariIni), 'Rit hari ini'], [nf.format(s.volHariIni) + ' m\u00b3', 'Volume hari ini'],
    [s.dtAktif, 'DT aktif hari ini'], [nf.format(s.volTotal) + ' m\u00b3', 'Total material dipindah']]
    .map(x => `<div class="stat"><b>${x[0]}</b><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');
  fillSel('gDt', g.dt); fillSel('gExc', g.exc);
  const curB = $('gExcB').value;
  $('gExcB').innerHTML = '<option value="">- Tidak ada -</option>' + g.exc.map(a => `<option value="${esc(a.kode)}">${esc(a.kode)} - ${esc(a.nama)}</option>`).join('');
  if (curB) $('gExcB').value = curB;
  $('gProg').innerHTML = progHtml('Total langsiran', g.progres);
  $('dlAsal').innerHTML = g.lokasi.asal.map(x => `<option value="${esc(x)}">`).join('');
  $('dlTujuan').innerHTML = g.lokasi.tujuan.map(x => `<option value="${esc(x)}">`).join('');
  renderBars('gBarVol', g.perDT, 'vol', 'bbm', 'm\u00b3');
  renderBars('gBarRit', g.perDT, 'rit', 'jam', 'rit');
  renderBars('gBarRute', g.perRute, 'vol', 'bbm', 'm\u00b3', 'rute');
  $('gLog').innerHTML = g.terbaru.length
    ? '<tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>DT</th><th>Sopir</th><th>Pemuat</th><th>Bongkar</th><th>Rute</th><th>Material</th><th>Rit</th><th>Volume</th><th>Catatan</th></tr>' +
      g.terbaru.map(l => `<tr><td>${esc(l.tanggal)}</td><td>${esc(l.kode)}</td><td>${esc(l.sopir)}</td><td>${esc(l.excavator)}</td><td>${esc(l.excBongkar) || '-'}</td><td>${esc(l.asal)} \u2192 ${esc(l.tujuan)}</td><td><span class="tag">${esc(l.material)}</span></td><td>${l.rit}</td><td>${nf.format(l.vol)} m\u00b3</td><td>${esc(l.catatan) || '-'}</td></tr>`).join('')
    : '<tr><td>Belum ada data langsir. Isi formulir di atas untuk mulai mencatat.</td></tr>';
}
const gf = $('g');
gf.tanggal.value = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
function hitungVol() { $('gVol').textContent = 'Volume: ' + nf.format((+$('gRit').value || 0) * (+$('gKap').value || 0)) + ' m\u00b3'; }
$('gRit').oninput = hitungVol; $('gKap').oninput = hitungVol;
function gShow(t, c) { const m = $('gMsg'); m.textContent = t; m.className = 'msg ' + c; }
gf.onsubmit = e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  $('gBtn').disabled = true; gShow('Menyimpan...', 'ok');
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(d => { render(d); gShow('Langsir tersimpan.', 'ok'); $('gBtn').disabled = false; $('gRit').value = ''; hitungVol(); })
    .withFailureHandler(err => { gShow(err.message, 'err'); $('gBtn').disabled = false; })
    .saveLangsir(Object.fromEntries(new FormData(gf)));
};
$('tabs').onclick = e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
  [...$('tabs').children].forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-selected', x === b));
  ['tabAlat', 'tabLangsir', 'tabGalian', 'tabProd', 'tabLaporan'].forEach(t => $(t).hidden = t !== b.dataset.t);
  if (b.dataset.t === 'tabGalian') { loadGalian(); loadRekapGalian('minggu'); }
  if (b.dataset.t === 'tabProd') loadProd();
  if (b.dataset.t === 'tabLaporan') loadLaporan();
};

/* ===== Progres total ===== */
function progHtml(judul, q) {
  const w = Math.min(100, q.capai).toFixed(1);
  return `<div class="brow wide"><div class="n" style="white-space:normal">${esc(judul)}: ${nf.format(q.real)} / ${nf.format(q.target)} m\u00b3 (${nf.format(q.capai)}%)</div>
    <div class="track"><div class="fill ${q.capai >= 100 ? 'ok' : 'mid'}" style="width:${w}%"></div></div></div>
    <p class="sub" style="margin:6px 0 0">Sisa ${nf.format(q.sisa)} m\u00b3.` +
    (q.estHari ? ` Dengan rata-rata ${nf.format(q.rata)} m\u00b3 per hari kerja, perkiraan selesai ${nf.format(q.estHari)} hari kerja lagi.` : q.sisa > 0 ? '' : ' Target tercapai.') + '</p>';
}

/* ===== Hasil Galian ===== */
let GA = null, GR = 14;
const klas = c => c >= 100 ? 'ok' : c >= 75 ? 'mid' : 'low';
const nilaiG = c => c >= 100 ? ['Tercapai', 'Beroperasi'] : c >= 75 ? ['Hampir', 'Standby'] : ['Belum', 'Rusak'];

function loadGalian() {
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(renderGalian)
    .withFailureHandler(err => { $('gaInfo').textContent = 'Gagal memuat: ' + err.message; })
    .getHasilGalian(GR);
}

function renderGaChart(p) {
  const data = p.harian, tgt = data[0].target;
  if (!data.some(h => h.total > 0)) {
    $('gaChart').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Belum ada data galian pada rentang ini. Catat langsir dengan memilih excavator pemuat.</div>'; return;
  }
  const W = 700, H = 260, L = 48, R = 14, T = 22, B = 28, iw = W - L - R, ih = H - T - B;
  const rawMax = Math.max(tgt, ...data.map(h => h.total));
  const step = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(rawMax / 4 || 1)));
  const unit = [1, 2, 2.5, 5, 10].map(m => m * step).find(u => u * 4 >= rawMax) || step * 10;
  const max = unit * 4;
  const Y = v => T + ih - v / max * ih;
  const bw = iw / data.length, cw = Math.min(34, bw * 0.62);
  const col = { ok: '#1f7a45', mid: '#f5c400', low: '#b3261e' };
  let g = '';
  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
    const y = Y(unit * i);
    g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="#e3e5e7"/><text x="${L - 6}" y="${y + 4}" text-anchor="end">${nf.format(unit * i)}</text>`;
  }
  const bars = data.map((h, i) => {
    if (!h.total) return '';
    const x = L + i * bw + (bw - cw) / 2, y = Y(h.total);
    return `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" width="${cw.toFixed(1)}" height="${(T + ih - y).toFixed(1)}" fill="${col[klas(h.capai)]}"><title>${tgl(h.tanggal)}: ${nf.format(h.total)} m\u00b3 (${nf.format(h.capai)}% dari target ${nf.format(h.target)} m\u00b3)</title></rect>` +
      (data.length <= 14 ? `<text class="val" x="${(x + cw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${(y - 5).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="middle">${nf.format(h.total)}</text>` : '');
  }).join('');
  const every = Math.ceil(data.length / 7);
  const xl = data.map((h, i) => (i % every === 0 || i === data.length - 1)
    ? `<text x="${(L + i * bw + bw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle">${tgl(h.tanggal)}</text>` : '').join('');
  const tline = tgt > 0
    ? `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${Y(tgt)}" y2="${Y(tgt)}" stroke="#1d2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/><text class="val" x="${W - R}" y="${Y(tgt) - 6}" text-anchor="end">Target ${nf.format(tgt)} m\u00b3</text>` : '';
  $('gaChart').innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Grafik volume galian harian dibanding target">${g}${bars}${tline}${xl}<text x="${L}" y="12">m\u00b3</text></svg>`;
}

function renderCapai(id, rows) {
  if (!rows.length) { $(id).innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Belum ada excavator. Tambahkan alat berjenis Excavator di sheet Alat.</div>'; return; }
  const max = Math.max(120, ...rows.map(r => r.capai));
  $(id).innerHTML = rows.map(r => {
    const w = (r.capai / max * 100).toFixed(1), m = (100 / max * 100).toFixed(1);
    return `<div class="brow wide"><div class="n" title="${esc(r.nama)}">${esc(r.kode)} \u2014 ${nf.format(r.capai)}% (${nf.format(r.vol)} / ${nf.format(r.targetPeriode)} m\u00b3)</div>
      <div class="track"><div class="fill ${klas(r.capai)}" style="width:${w}%"></div><div class="mark" style="left:${m}%"></div></div></div>`;
  }).join('');
}

function setGaTarget() {
  if (!GA) return;
  const e = GA.excavators.find(x => x.kode === $('gaKode').value);
  $('gaTarget').value = e ? e.target : '';
}

function renderGalian(p) {
  GA = p; const s = p.ringkas;
  $('gaStats').innerHTML = [
    [nf.format(s.vol) + ' m\u00b3', 'Total galian ' + p.days + ' hari'],
    [nf.format(s.target) + ' m\u00b3', 'Target (' + s.hariKerja + ' hari kerja)'],
    [nf.format(s.capai) + '%', 'Capaian target'],
    [s.hariCapai + ' / ' + s.hariKerja, 'Hari target tercapai']
  ].map(x => `<div class="stat"><b>${x[0]}</b><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');

  const msgs = [], ada = p.excavators.filter(e => e.vol > 0);
  if (ada.length) {
    const top = ada.slice().sort((a, b) => b.vol - a.vol)[0];
    msgs.push(`Galian terbanyak: <b>${esc(top.kode)}</b> (${nf.format(top.vol)} m\u00b3).`);
    const low = ada.slice().sort((a, b) => a.capai - b.capai)[0];
    if (low.capai < 75) msgs.push(`Capaian terendah: <b>${esc(low.kode)}</b> (${nf.format(low.capai)}%). Cek jam kerja alat dan ketersediaan DT.`);
  }
  if (p.tanpaExc > 0) msgs.push(`${nf.format(p.tanpaExc)} m\u00b3 langsir belum tercatat excavator pemuatnya, jadi tidak masuk hitungan per alat.`);
  $('gaInfo').innerHTML = msgs.length ? msgs.join(' ') : 'Belum ada data galian pada periode ini. Catat langsir dan pilih excavator pemuat.';

  renderGaChart(p);
  $('gaProg').innerHTML = progHtml('Total galian', p.progres.galian);
  renderCapai('gaBarCapai', p.excavators);
  fillSel('gaKode', p.excavators); setGaTarget();

  const ex = p.excavators;
  $('gaRekap').innerHTML = ex.length
    ? '<tr><th>Excavator</th><th>Target/hari</th><th>Hari kerja</th><th>Volume (m\u00b3)</th><th>Rata-rata/hari</th><th>Target periode</th><th>Capaian</th><th>Hari tercapai</th><th>Catatan hasil galian</th></tr>' +
      ex.map(r => { const n = nilaiG(r.capai); return `<tr><td>${esc(r.kode)} - ${esc(r.nama)}</td><td>${nf.format(r.target)} m\u00b3${r.custom ? '' : ' <span class="tag">default</span>'}</td><td>${r.hari}</td><td>${nf.format(r.vol)}</td><td>${r.rata ? nf.format(r.rata) : '-'}</td><td>${nf.format(r.targetPeriode)}</td><td>${nf.format(r.capai)}% <span class="b ${n[1]}">${n[0]}</span></td><td>${r.hariCapai} / ${s.hariKerja}</td><td style="white-space:normal;min-width:180px">${esc(r.catatan) || '-'}</td></tr>`; }).join('')
    : '<tr><td>Belum ada excavator terdaftar di sheet Alat.</td></tr>';

  const tx = p.tanpaExc > 0;
  const rowTanpa = h => +(h.total - ex.reduce((t, e) => t + h.perExc[e.kode], 0)).toFixed(1);
  $('gaHarian').innerHTML = '<tr><th>Tanggal</th>' + ex.map(e => `<th title="${esc(e.nama)}">${esc(e.kode)}</th>`).join('') + (tx ? '<th>Tanpa excavator</th>' : '') + '<th>Total (m\u00b3)</th><th>Target</th><th>Capaian</th><th>Catatan hasil galian</th></tr>' +
    p.harian.slice().reverse().map(h => {
      const lbl = new Date(h.tanggal + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
      const cells = ex.map(e => { const v = h.perExc[e.kode]; return `<td class="${v >= e.target ? 'okc' : v > 0 ? 'lowc' : ''}">${v ? nf.format(v) : '-'}</td>`; }).join('');
      const n = nilaiG(h.capai);
      return `<tr><td>${esc(lbl)}</td>${cells}${tx ? `<td>${rowTanpa(h) ? nf.format(rowTanpa(h)) : '-'}</td>` : ''}<td><b>${h.total ? nf.format(h.total) : '-'}</b></td><td>${nf.format(h.target)}</td><td>${h.aktif ? nf.format(h.capai) + '% <span class="b ' + n[1] + '">' + n[0] + '</span>' : '-'}</td><td style="white-space:normal;min-width:180px">${esc(h.catatan) || '-'}</td></tr>`;
    }).join('') +
    `<tr class="tot"><td>Total</td>${ex.map(e => `<td>${nf.format(e.vol)}</td>`).join('')}${tx ? `<td>${nf.format(p.tanpaExc)}</td>` : ''}<td>${nf.format(s.vol)}</td><td>${nf.format(s.target)}</td><td>${nf.format(s.capai)}%</td><td>-</td></tr>`;
}


function loadRekapGalian(mode) {
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(p => renderRekapGalian(p))
    .withFailureHandler(err => { $('gaRekapPeriode').innerHTML = `<tr><td>Gagal memuat rekap: ${esc(err.message)}</td></tr>`; })
    .getRekapGalian(mode);
}
function renderRekapGalian(p) {
  const ex = p.excavators || [], rows = p.rows || [];
  if (!rows.length) { $('gaRekapPeriode').innerHTML = '<tr><td>Belum ada data hasil galian.</td></tr>'; return; }
  $('gaRekapPeriode').innerHTML = '<tr><th>Periode</th><th>Hari ada produksi</th>' + ex.map(e => `<th>${esc(e.kode)} (m³)</th>`).join('') + '<th>Total (m³)</th><th>Rit</th><th>Target (m³)</th><th>Capaian</th><th>Tanpa excavator</th><th>Catatan hasil galian</th></tr>' +
    rows.map(r => `<tr><td>${esc(r.label)}</td><td>${r.hari}</td>${ex.map(e => `<td>${r.perExc[e.kode] ? nf.format(r.perExc[e.kode]) : '-'}</td>`).join('')}<td><b>${nf.format(r.vol)}</b></td><td>${nf.format(r.rit)}</td><td>${nf.format(r.target)}</td><td>${nf.format(r.capai)}%</td><td>${r.tanpaExc ? nf.format(r.tanpaExc) : '-'}</td><td style="white-space:normal;min-width:180px">${esc(r.catatan) || '-'}</td></tr>`).join('');
}
$('gaRekapMode').onclick = e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
  [...$('gaRekapMode').children].forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === b));
  loadRekapGalian(b.dataset.mode);
};

$('gaRng').onclick = e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
  GR = +b.dataset.d;
  [...$('gaRng').children].forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === b));
  loadGalian();
};
$('gaKode').onchange = setGaTarget;
function gaShow(t, c) { const m = $('gaMsg'); m.textContent = t; m.className = 'msg ' + c; }
$('gaForm').onsubmit = e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  $('gaBtn').disabled = true; gaShow('Menyimpan...', 'ok');
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(p => { renderGalian(p); gaShow('Target tersimpan.', 'ok'); $('gaBtn').disabled = false; })
    .withFailureHandler(err => { gaShow(err.message, 'err'); $('gaBtn').disabled = false; })
    .setTargetGalian($('gaKode').value, $('gaTarget').value, GR);
};

/* ===== Produktivitas ===== */
let PR = 30;
function loadProd() {
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(renderProd)
    .withFailureHandler(err => { $('pInfo').textContent = 'Gagal memuat: ' + err.message; })
    .getProduktivitas(PR);
}
function renderProd(p) {
  const s = p.ringkas, dash = v => v ? nf.format(v) : '-';
  $('pTarget').textContent = p.target;
  $('pStats').innerHTML = [[dash(s.prodDT) + (s.prodDT ? ' m\u00b3/jam' : ''), 'Produktivitas rata-rata DT'], [nf.format(s.util) + '%', 'Utilisasi rata-rata alat'],
    [nf.format(s.vol) + ' m\u00b3', 'Material dipindah (' + nf.format(s.rit) + ' rit)'], [dash(s.lM3) + (s.lM3 ? ' L/m\u00b3' : ''), 'BBM per m\u00b3 material']]
    .map(x => `<div class="stat"><b>${x[0]}</b><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');

  const aktif = p.rows.filter(r => r.hari > 0);
  const msgs = [];
  const bestDT = p.rows.filter(r => r.jenis === 'DT' && r.prod > 0).sort((a, b) => b.prod - a.prod)[0];
  if (bestDT) msgs.push(`DT paling produktif: <b>${esc(bestDT.kode)}</b> (${nf.format(bestDT.prod)} m\u00b3/jam).`);
  const low = aktif.slice().sort((a, b) => a.util - b.util)[0];
  if (low && low.util < 50) msgs.push(`Utilisasi terendah: <b>${esc(low.kode)}</b> (${nf.format(low.util)}%). Cek apakah alat sering standby atau rusak.`);
  const hi = aktif.slice().sort((a, b) => b.lJam - a.lJam)[0];
  if (hi && hi.lJam > 0) msgs.push(`BBM per jam tertinggi: <b>${esc(hi.kode)}</b> (${nf.format(hi.lJam)} L/jam).`);
  $('pInfo').innerHTML = msgs.length ? msgs.join(' ') : 'Belum cukup data pada periode ini. Isi pemakaian alat dan langsir galian untuk melihat produktivitas.';

  renderBars('pBarDT', p.rows.filter(r => r.jenis === 'DT'), 'prod', 'bbm', 'm\u00b3/jam');
  renderBars('pBarExc', p.rows.filter(r => r.jenis === 'EXC'), 'prod', 'bbm', 'm\u00b3/jam');
  renderBars('pBarUtil', aktif, 'util', 'jam', '%');

  const nilai = u => u >= 75 ? ['Baik', 'Beroperasi'] : u >= 50 ? ['Cukup', 'Standby'] : ['Rendah', 'Rusak'];
  $('pTabel').innerHTML = aktif.length
    ? '<tr><th>Alat</th><th>Jam kerja</th><th>Volume (m\u00b3)</th><th>m\u00b3/jam</th><th>L/jam</th><th>L/m\u00b3</th><th>Utilisasi</th><th>Ketersediaan</th></tr>' +
      aktif.map(r => { const n = nilai(r.util); return `<tr><td>${esc(r.kode)} <span class="tag">${esc(r.jenis === 'LAIN' ? 'Lainnya' : r.jenis)}</span></td><td>${nf.format(r.jam)}</td><td>${dash(r.vol)}</td><td>${dash(r.prod)}</td><td>${dash(r.lJam)}</td><td>${dash(r.lM3)}</td>
        <td><span class="meter"><i style="width:${r.util}%"></i></span>${nf.format(r.util)}% <span class="b ${n[1]}">${n[0]}</span></td><td>${nf.format(r.avail)}%</td></tr>`; }).join('')
    : '<tr><td>Belum ada data pada periode ini.</td></tr>';
}
$('pRng').onclick = e => {
  const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
  PR = +b.dataset.d;
  [...$('pRng').children].forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === b));
  $('pInfo').textContent = 'Memuat data...';
  loadProd();
};

/* ===== Laporan Harian ===== */
function tglPanjang(s) { return new Date(s + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }); }
let LAP = null;
$('lTgl').value = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
function loadLaporan() {
  $('lKertas').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Memuat laporan...</div>';
  google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(renderLaporan)
    .withFailureHandler(err => { $('lKertas').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Gagal memuat: ' + esc(err.message) + '</div>'; })
    .getLaporanHarian($('lTgl').value);
}
function renderLaporan(r) {
  LAP = r; const s = r.ringkas;
  const stat = (v, t) => `<div class="stat"><b>${v}</b><span>${t}</span></div>`;
  const alat = r.alat.length
    ? '<tr><th>Alat</th><th>Operator</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>HM awal</th><th>HM akhir</th><th>Jam</th><th>BBM (L)</th><th>Status</th><th>Catatan</th></tr>' +
      r.alat.map(l => `<tr><td>${esc(l.kode)} ${esc(l.nama)}</td><td>${esc(l.operator)}</td><td>${esc(l.lokasi)}</td><td>${l.hmAwal}</td><td>${l.hmAkhir}</td><td>${nf.format(l.jam)}</td><td>${nf.format(l.bbm)}</td><td><span class="b ${esc(l.status)}">${esc(l.status)}</span></td><td>${esc(l.catatan)}</td></tr>`).join('') +
      `<tr class="tot"><td colspan="5">Total</td><td>${nf.format(s.jam)}</td><td>${nf.format(s.bbm)}</td><td colspan="2"></td></tr>`
    : '<tr><td>Tidak ada data pemakaian alat pada tanggal ini.</td></tr>';
  const gal = r.galian.length
    ? '<tr><th>Excavator</th><th>Target (m\u00b3)</th><th>Hasil (m\u00b3)</th><th>Rit</th><th>Capaian</th><th>Keterangan</th><th>Catatan hasil galian</th></tr>' +
      r.galian.map(g => { const n = nilaiG(g.capai); return `<tr><td>${esc(g.kode)} ${esc(g.nama)}</td><td>${nf.format(g.target)}</td><td>${nf.format(g.vol)}</td><td>${g.rit}</td><td>${nf.format(g.capai)}%</td><td><span class="b ${n[1]}">${n[0]}</span></td><td style="white-space:normal">${esc(g.catatan) || '-'}</td></tr>`; }).join('') +
      (r.volTanpaExc > 0 ? `<tr><td>Excavator tidak tercatat</td><td></td><td>${nf.format(r.volTanpaExc)}</td><td></td><td></td><td></td></tr>` : '') +
      `<tr class="tot"><td>Total</td><td>${nf.format(s.targetGalian)}</td><td>${nf.format(s.volGalian)}</td><td>${s.rit}</td><td>${nf.format(s.capaiGalian)}%</td><td></td></tr>`
    : '<tr><td>Belum ada excavator terdaftar.</td></tr>';
  const lang = r.langsir.length
    ? '<tr><th>DT</th><th>Sopir</th><th>Exc. Pemuat</th><th>Exc. Bongkar</th><th>Rute</th><th>Material</th><th>Rit</th><th>Volume (m\u00b3)</th></tr>' +
      r.langsir.map(l => `<tr><td>${esc(l.kode)}</td><td>${esc(l.sopir)}</td><td>${esc(l.excavator)}</td><td>${esc(l.excBongkar) || '-'}</td><td>${esc(l.asal)} \u2192 ${esc(l.tujuan)}</td><td>${esc(l.material)}</td><td>${l.rit}</td><td>${nf.format(l.vol)}</td></tr>`).join('') +
      `<tr class="tot"><td colspan="6">Total</td><td>${nf.format(s.rit)}</td><td>${nf.format(s.volume)}</td></tr>`
    : '<tr><td>Tidak ada data langsir pada tanggal ini.</td></tr>';
  const ken = r.kendala.length ? '<ul>' + r.kendala.map(k => `<li><b>${esc(k.kode)}</b> (${esc(k.sumber)}): ${esc(k.teks)}</li>`).join('') + '</ul>' : '<div class="info">Tidak ada kendala atau catatan.</div>';
  const bl = r.belumLapor.length ? r.belumLapor.map(esc).join(', ') : 'Semua alat sudah dilaporkan.';
  $('lKertas').innerHTML = `<div class="rhead"><h2>LAPORAN HARIAN ALAT BERAT</h2>${r.proyek ? `<div>${esc(r.proyek)}</div>` : ''}<div>${esc(tglPanjang(r.tanggal))}</div></div>
    <div class="stats">${stat(s.beroperasi, 'Alat beroperasi')}${stat(s.standby, 'Alat standby')}${stat(s.rusak, 'Alat rusak')}${stat(nf.format(s.jam), 'Jam kerja')}${stat(nf.format(s.bbm) + ' L', 'BBM terpakai')}${stat(nf.format(s.volGalian) + ' / ' + nf.format(s.targetGalian) + ' m\u00b3', 'Hasil galian vs target (' + nf.format(s.capaiGalian) + '%)')}${stat(s.rit + ' rit', 'Langsir galian')}${stat(s.prodDT ? nf.format(s.prodDT) + ' m\u00b3/jam' : '-', 'Produktivitas DT')}</div>
    <h3>Progres total volume (kumulatif s.d. tanggal ini)</h3>${progHtml('Total galian', r.progres.galian)}<div style="height:10px"></div>${progHtml('Total langsiran', r.progres.langsir)}
    <h3>A. Pemakaian alat</h3><div class="scroll"><table class="wide">${alat}</table></div>
    <h3>B. Hasil galian per excavator</h3><div class="scroll"><table>${gal}</table></div>
    <h3>C. Langsir bekas galian (DT)</h3><div class="scroll"><table>${lang}</table></div>
    <h3>D. Kendala dan catatan</h3>${ken}
    <h3>E. Alat belum dilaporkan</h3><div>${bl}</div>
    <div class="sign"><div><span>Dibuat oleh</span></div><div><span>Mengetahui</span></div></div>`;
}
function waText(r) {
  const s = r.ringkas, n = x => nf.format(x);
  let t = `*LAPORAN HARIAN ALAT BERAT*\n${r.proyek ? r.proyek + '\n' : ''}${tglPanjang(r.tanggal)}\n\n*Ringkasan*\n` +
    `- Beroperasi: ${s.beroperasi} | Standby: ${s.standby} | Rusak: ${s.rusak}\n- Jam kerja: ${n(s.jam)} jam\n- BBM: ${n(s.bbm)} L\n- Galian: ${n(s.volGalian)} / ${n(s.targetGalian)} m\u00b3 (${n(s.capaiGalian)}%)\n- Langsir: ${s.rit} rit\n` +
    (s.prodDT ? `- Produktivitas DT: ${n(s.prodDT)} m\u00b3/jam\n` : '');
  t += '\n*Progres kumulatif*\n- Galian: ' + n(r.progres.galian.real) + ' / ' + n(r.progres.galian.target) + ' m\u00b3 (' + n(r.progres.galian.capai) + '%)\n- Langsiran: ' + n(r.progres.langsir.real) + ' / ' + n(r.progres.langsir.target) + ' m\u00b3 (' + n(r.progres.langsir.capai) + '%)\n';
  if (r.galian.length) t += '\n*Hasil galian vs target*\n' + r.galian.map(g => `- ${g.kode}: ${n(g.vol)} / ${n(g.target)} m\u00b3 (${n(g.capai)}%)${g.catatan ? '\n  Catatan: ' + g.catatan : ''}`).join('\n') + (r.volTanpaExc > 0 ? `\n- Excavator tidak tercatat: ${n(r.volTanpaExc)} m\u00b3` : '') + '\n';
  if (r.alat.length) t += '\n*Pemakaian alat*\n' + r.alat.map((l, i) => `${i + 1}. ${l.kode} | ${l.operator} | ${l.lokasi || '-'} | ${n(l.jam)} jam | ${n(l.bbm)} L | ${l.status}`).join('\n') + '\n';
  if (r.langsir.length) t += '\n*Langsir DT*\n' + r.langsir.map(l => `- ${l.kode} (${l.sopir}): ${l.rit} rit, ${n(l.vol)} m\u00b3, ${l.asal} \u2192 ${l.tujuan}${l.excBongkar ? ' (bongkar: ' + l.excBongkar + ')' : ''}`).join('\n') + '\n';
  if (r.kendala.length) t += '\n*Kendala*\n' + r.kendala.map(k => `- ${k.kode}: ${k.teks}`).join('\n') + '\n';
  if (r.belumLapor.length) t += '\n*Belum lapor*: ' + r.belumLapor.map(x => x.split(' - ')[0]).join(', ') + '\n';
  return t.trim();
}
function lShow(t, c) { const m = $('lMsg'); m.textContent = t; m.className = 'msg ' + c; }
$('lTgl').onchange = loadLaporan;
$('lPrint').onclick = () => window.print();
$('lWa').onclick = () => {
  if (!LAP) return;
  const t = waText(LAP), box = $('lBox');
  box.hidden = false; box.value = t; box.select();
  let ok = false; try { ok = document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
  lShow(ok ? 'Laporan tersalin. Tempel di WhatsApp.' : 'Salin manual teks di kotak bawah ini, lalu tempel di WhatsApp.', ok ? 'ok' : 'err');
};

function hint() {
  if (!D) return;
  const hm = D.hmTerakhir[$('kode').value] || 0;
  $('hmAwal').value = hm || '';
  $('hint').textContent = hm ? 'HM terakhir: ' + hm : '';
  hitung();
}
function hitung() {
  const j = (parseFloat($('hmAkhir').value) || 0) - (parseFloat($('hmAwal').value) || 0);
  $('jam').textContent = 'Jam kerja: ' + (j > 0 ? j.toFixed(1) : 0);
}
$('kode').onchange = hint; $('hmAwal').oninput = hitung; $('hmAkhir').oninput = hitung;

function show(t, c) { const m = $('msg'); m.textContent = t; m.className = 'msg ' + c; }

f.onsubmit = e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(f));
  $('btn').disabled = true; show('Menyimpan...', 'ok');
  google.script.run
    .withSuccessHandler(d => { render(d); show('Data tersimpan.', 'ok'); $('btn').disabled = false; $('hmAkhir').value = ''; hitung(); })
    .withFailureHandler(err => { show(err.message, 'err'); $('btn').disabled = false; })
    .saveLog(data);
};

google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(render)
  .withFailureHandler(err => show('Gagal memuat data: ' + err.message + ' (jalankan setup() dulu)', 'err'))
  .getData();
</script>
</body>
</html><!-- Form "Catat hasil galian" + data total volume galian. Disisipkan otomatis ke Index.html oleh doGet() di Code.gs. -->
<style>
.gi-hi{border-left:5px solid var(--y)}
.gi-note{background:#fff8d6;border-left:4px solid var(--y);padding:8px 12px;font-size:13px;margin:0 0 12px}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  const pane = document.getElementById('tabGalian');
  if (!pane) return;
  const sec = document.createElement('section');
  sec.id = 'giSec';
  sec.innerHTML = `
    <h2>Catat hasil galian</h2>
    <p class="sub">Catat volume material yang digali tiap excavator. Data masuk ke sheet Galian dan langsung dihitung di grafik, rekap, laporan harian, dan total target.</p>
    <div class="gi-note">Jika excavator dan tanggal yang sama sudah dicatat di sini, angka ini dipakai. Jika belum, dipakai hitungan otomatis dari catatan langsir (excavator pemuat). Tidak ada hitungan ganda.</div>
    <div class="stats" id="giTotal" style="margin-bottom:14px"></div>
    <form id="giForm">
      <label>Tanggal<input type="date" name="tanggal" required></label>
      <label>Excavator<select name="excavator" id="giExc" required></select></label>
      <label>Lokasi galian<input name="lokasi" list="dlLokGal" autocomplete="off" placeholder="mis. Pit A"></label>
      <label>Material<select name="material"><option>Tanah</option><option>Batu</option><option>Lumpur</option><option>Campuran</option></select></label>
      <label>Volume hasil galian (m\u00b3)<input type="number" min="0.1" step="0.1" name="vol" required></label>
      <label>Rit DT dimuat (opsional)<input type="number" min="0" step="1" name="rit"></label>
      <label class="full">Catatan hasil galian<textarea name="catatan" rows="2" placeholder="Contoh: material keras, ada batu besar, area berlumpur, alat sempat berhenti"></textarea></label>
      <div class="full"><button id="giBtn">Simpan hasil galian</button><div class="msg" id="giMsg"></div></div>
    </form>
    <datalist id="dlLokGal"></datalist>
    <h2 style="margin-top:22px">Kontribusi per excavator terhadap total</h2>
    <p class="sub">Volume galian kumulatif sejak awal proyek.</p>
    <div class="bars" id="giKum"></div>
    <h2 style="margin-top:22px">Catatan hasil galian terbaru</h2>
    <div class="scroll"><table id="giLog"></table></div>`;
  pane.insertBefore(sec, pane.children[1] || null);

  const f = document.getElementById('giForm');
  f.tanggal.value = new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-CA');
  const msg = (t, c) => { const m = $('giMsg'); m.textContent = t; m.className = 'msg ' + c; };

  window.renderInputGalian = function (p) {
    const g = p.progres.galian;
    $('giTotal').innerHTML = [
      [nf.format(g.target) + ' m\u00b3', 'Target total galian'],
      [nf.format(g.real) + ' m\u00b3', 'Sudah digali (' + nf.format(g.capai) + '%)'],
      [nf.format(g.sisa) + ' m\u00b3', 'Sisa volume'],
      [g.estHari ? nf.format(g.estHari) + ' hari kerja' : (g.sisa > 0 ? '-' : 'Selesai'), 'Perkiraan selesai']
    ].map(x => `<div class="stat gi-hi"><b>${x[0]}</b><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');
    fillSel('giExc', p.excavators);
    $('dlLokGal').innerHTML = (p.lokasiGalian || []).map(x => `<option value="${esc(x)}">`).join('');
    renderBars('giKum', p.kumulatif || [], 'vol', 'bbm', 'm\u00b3');
    const t = p.terbaruInput || [];
    $('giLog').innerHTML = t.length
      ? '<tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Excavator</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Material</th><th>Volume</th><th>Rit</th><th>Catatan</th></tr>' +
        t.map(l => `<tr><td>${esc(l.tanggal)}</td><td>${esc(l.excavator)}</td><td>${esc(l.lokasi) || '-'}</td><td><span class="tag">${esc(l.material)}</span></td><td>${nf.format(l.vol)} m\u00b3</td><td>${l.rit || '-'}</td><td style="white-space:normal;min-width:160px">${esc(l.catatan) || '-'}</td></tr>`).join('')
      : '<tr><td>Belum ada catatan hasil galian. Isi formulir di atas untuk mulai mencatat.</td></tr>';
  };

  // Sambungkan ke render Hasil Galian yang sudah ada
  const asli = renderGalian;
  renderGalian = function (p) { asli(p); window.renderInputGalian(p); };

  f.onsubmit = e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const data = Object.fromEntries(new FormData(f));
    $('giBtn').disabled = true; msg('Menyimpan...', 'ok');
    google.script.run
      .withSuccessHandler(p => {
        renderGalian(p); msg('Hasil galian tersimpan.', 'ok');
        $('giBtn').disabled = false; f.vol.value = ''; f.rit.value = ''; f.catatan.value = '';
        const on = document.querySelector('#gaRekapMode [aria-pressed=true]');
        loadRekapGalian(on ? on.dataset.mode : 'minggu');
      })
      .withFailureHandler(err => { msg(err.message, 'err'); $('giBtn').disabled = false; })
      .saveGalian(data, GR);
  };
})();
</script><style>

<script>
(function(){

  const tick=()=>{const d=new Date();c.textContent=d.toLocaleDateString('id-ID',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'})+'  \u2022  '+d.toLocaleTimeString('id-ID',{hour12:false}).replace(/\./g,':');};
  tick(); setInterval(tick,1000);
})();

#tabRingkas .db-k .db-pct{display:inline;font-size:15px;white-space:nowrap}
#dbCmp text{font:11px system-ui,sans-serif;fill:#666d75}#dbCmp text.cl{fill:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:13px}
#tabRingkas .db-hero{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#0e7490,#1e63c8 55%,#7b3fe0);color:#fff;border:0;border-top:5px solid #f5c400;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.db-hero .info{color:#e3ecff}
.db-w{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(150px,100%),1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.db-w>div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;font-size:12px;color:#e3ecff;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.db-w b{display:block;font-size:20px;color:#fff;line-height:1.25}
.db-wb{height:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:5px;margin-top:10px}.db-wb i{display:block;height:100%;background:#f5c400;border-radius:5px}
.db-wl{font-size:12px;color:#e3ecff;margin-top:4px}
.db-wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin-top:14px}
.db-wc{flex:1;min-width:min(260px,100%)}.db-wc .db-w{margin-top:0}
.db-hg{width:78px;flex:none}.db-hg svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible;animation:hgSway 4s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:50% 50%}
.hg-st{stroke-dasharray:3 3;animation:hgFall .5s linear infinite}
.hg-gr{animation:hgGrain 1.05s linear infinite;opacity:0}
@keyframes hgSway{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-4deg)}50%{transform:rotate(4deg)}}
@keyframes hgFall{to{stroke-dashoffset:-6}}
@keyframes hgGrain{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(var(--d));opacity:.15}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.db-hg svg,.hg-st,.hg-gr{animation:none}.hg-gr{opacity:1}}
.db-hero .hint{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-left-color:#f5c400;color:#fff}
.db-hero .seg{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.db-hero .seg button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
.db-hero .seg button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#f5c400;color:#1d2125}
</style>
<script>
(function () {
  const pane = document.createElement('div');
  pane.className = 'pane'; pane.id = 'tabRingkas'; pane.hidden = true;
  pane.innerHTML = `
  <section class="db-hero"><div class="db-top"><div><h2>Ringkasan Proyek</h2><div class="info" id="dbTgl"></div></div>
    <div class="seg" id="dbRng" role="group" aria-label="Rentang waktu">
      <button type="button" data-d="7" aria-pressed="false">7 hari</button>
      <button type="button" data-d="14" aria-pressed="true">14 hari</button>
      <button type="button" data-d="30" aria-pressed="false">30 hari</button></div></div>
    <div id="dbWaktu"></div>
    <div class="hint" id="dbInfo" style="margin-top:12px">Memuat data...</div></section>
  <div class="db-lbl">Total keseluruhan pencapaian sejak awal proyek</div><div class="db-main"><div id="dbK1"></div><div class="db-right"><div class="stats" id="dbK"></div>
  <section class="line"><h2>Perbandingan pemakaian alat, BBM, dan hasil galian</h2>
    <p class="sub">Batang biru = jam kerja, batang hijau = hasil galian, garis kuning = BBM. Ketiganya diskalakan terhadap puncaknya masing-masing (100%) supaya bisa dibandingkan. Arahkan kursor ke batang atau titik untuk melihat angka asli.</p>
    <div class="legend" id="dbCmpL"></div><div class="kpi" id="dbCmpK"></div><div id="dbCmp"></div></section>
  <div class="cols">
    <section class="line"><h2>Total pemakaian BBM</h2><div class="kpi" id="dbBbmK"></div><div id="dbBbm"></div></section>
    <section><h2>Status alat hari ini</h2><div class="db-donut" id="dbStatus"></div>
      <div class="stat db-ef" style="margin-top:14px"><span>Efisiensi operasional (utilisasi rata-rata)</span><b id="dbEf">-</b></div></section>
  </div></div></div>
  <div class="cols">
    <section class="line"><h2>Hasil galian harian vs target</h2><p class="sub">Garis putus-putus = target semua excavator per hari (m&sup3;).</p><div id="dbGal"></div></section>
    <section class="line"><h2>Volume langsir harian (DT)</h2><p class="sub">Material bekas galian yang diangkut (m&sup3;).</p><div id="dbLang"></div></section>
  </div>
  <div class="cols">
    <section><h2>Progres total galian</h2><div id="dbPg"></div></section>
    <section><h2>Progres total langsiran</h2><div id="dbPl"></div></section>
  </div>
  <div class="cols">
    <section><h2>Capaian excavator hari ini</h2><p class="sub">Garis hitam = target harian (100%).</p><div class="bars" id="dbExc"></div></section>
    <section><h2>Langsir DT hari ini</h2><div class="stats" id="dbL" style="margin-bottom:12px"></div>
      <p class="sub">Volume per DT pada periode terpilih (5 teratas).</p><div class="bars" id="dbDT"></div></section>
  </div>
  <div class="cols">
    <section><h2>Produktivitas alat</h2><div class="db-donut" id="dbProd"></div></section>
    <section><h2>Top 5 alat (utilisasi)</h2><p class="sub">Jam kerja dibanding target ${'8'} jam per hari.</p><div class="bars" id="dbTop"></div></section>
  </div>
  <section><h2>Rute langsir terbesar</h2><div class="bars" id="dbRute"></div></section>
  <section><h2>Aktivitas terbaru</h2><div class="scroll"><table id="dbAkt"></table></div></section>`;
  document.querySelector('main').insertBefore(pane, document.querySelector('main').firstChild);

  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.type = 'button'; btn.setAttribute('role', 'tab'); btn.dataset.t = 'tabRingkas';
  btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false'); btn.textContent = 'Ringkasan';
  $('tabs').insertBefore(btn, $('tabs').firstChild);

  [['dbBbm','alat'],['dbStatus','alat'],['dbAkt','alat'],['dbGal','gal'],['dbPg','gal'],['dbExc','gal'],
   ['dbLang','lang'],['dbPl','lang'],['dbDT','lang'],['dbRute','lang'],['dbProd','prod'],['dbTop','prod']]
    .forEach(x => $(x[0]).closest('section').classList.add('s-' + x[1]));
  let RG = 14;
  const load = () => google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(render)
    .withFailureHandler(err => { $('dbInfo').textContent = 'Gagal memuat: ' + err.message; }).getDashboard(RG);

  $('tabs').addEventListener('click', e => {
    const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
    const on = b.dataset.t === 'tabRingkas';
    pane.hidden = !on; if (on) load();
  });
  $('dbRng').onclick = e => {
    const b = e.target.closest('button'); if (!b) return;
    RG = +b.dataset.d;
    [...$('dbRng').children].forEach(x => x.setAttribute('aria-pressed', x === b));
    load();
  };

  function donut(parts, big, small) {
    const R = 52, C = 2 * Math.PI * R, tot = parts.reduce((t, p) => t + p.v, 0) || 1; let off = 0;
    return `<svg viewBox="0 0 140 140" width="160" role="img" aria-label="${esc(big + ' ' + small)}"><circle cx="70" cy="70" r="${R}" fill="none" stroke="#eef0f1" stroke-width="18"/>` +
      parts.map(p => { const l = p.v / tot * C, s = `<circle cx="70" cy="70" r="${R}" fill="none" stroke="${p.c}" stroke-width="18" stroke-dasharray="${l} ${C - l}" stroke-dashoffset="${-off}" transform="rotate(-90 70 70)"/>`; off += l; return s; }).join('') +
      `<text x="70" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="#1d2125">${big}</text><text x="70" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="#666d75">${small}</text></svg>`;
  }

  function chart(id, data, key, col, tgt) {
    if (!data.some(x => x[key] > 0)) { $(id).innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Belum ada data pada rentang ini.</div>'; return; }
    const W = 700, H = 230, L = 46, R = 12, T = 18, B = 26, iw = W - L - R, ih = H - T - B;
    const mx = Math.max(tgt || 0, ...data.map(x => x[key])) * 1.15 || 1;
    const Y = v => T + ih - v / mx * ih, bw = iw / data.length, cw = Math.min(30, bw * .6);
    let g = '';
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) { const v = mx * i / 4, y = Y(v); g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="#e3e5e7"/><text x="${L - 6}" y="${y + 4}" text-anchor="end">${nf.format(Math.round(v))}</text>`; }
    const cx = i => L + i * bw + bw / 2;
    const bars = data.map((x, i) => x[key] ? `<rect x="${(cx(i) - cw / 2).toFixed(1)}" y="${Y(x[key]).toFixed(1)}" width="${cw.toFixed(1)}" height="${(T + ih - Y(x[key])).toFixed(1)}" fill="${col}" opacity=".85"><title>${tgl(x.tanggal)}: ${nf.format(x[key])}</title></rect>` : '').join('');
    const pts = data.map((x, i) => cx(i).toFixed(1) + ',' + Y(x[key]).toFixed(1)).join(' ');
    const ev = Math.ceil(data.length / 7);
    const xl = data.map((x, i) => (i % ev === 0 || i === data.length - 1) ? `<text x="${cx(i).toFixed(1)}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle">${tgl(x.tanggal)}</text>` : '').join('');
    const tl = tgt > 0 ? `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${Y(tgt)}" y2="${Y(tgt)}" stroke="#1d2125" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/><text class="val" x="${W - R}" y="${Y(tgt) - 6}" text-anchor="end">Target ${nf.format(tgt)}</text>` : '';
    $(id).innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img">${g}${bars}<polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="#1d2125" stroke-width="2"/>${tl}${xl}</svg>`;
  }

  const MULAI = new Date(2026, 9, 16), BATAS = new Date(2026, 11, 31); // 16 Okt 2026 s.d. 31 Des 2026
  let WP = 0;
  function waktu() {
    const d = new Date(), t0 = new Date(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth(), d.getDate());
    const DAY = 864e5, total = Math.round((BATAS - MULAI) / DAY), jalan = Math.round((t0 - MULAI) / DAY), sisa = Math.round((BATAS - t0) / DAY);
    const fm = x => x.toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
    WP = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, jalan / total * 100));
    const jl = jalan < 0 ? 'Belum mulai' : jalan, sl = sisa < 0 ? 'Lewat ' + (-sisa) : sisa;
    const topH = (100 - WP) / 100 * 35, botH = WP / 100 * 35, botY = 80 - botH, run = jalan >= 0 && sisa > 0;
    const glass = 'M8 6H52V10C52 26 36 36 33 45C36 54 52 64 52 80V84H8V80C8 64 24 54 27 45C24 36 8 26 8 10Z';
    const hg = `<svg viewBox="0 0 60 90" role="img" aria-label="Jam pasir: waktu proyek terpakai ${nf.format(WP)} persen">
      <defs><clipPath id="hgC"><path d="${glass}"/></clipPath><linearGradient id="hgS" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#ffd84a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f08a00"/></linearGradient></defs>
      <rect x="4" y="1" width="52" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#f5c400"/><rect x="4" y="84" width="52" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="#f5c400"/>
      <path d="${glass}" fill="rgba(255,255,255,.14)"/>
      <g clip-path="url(#hgC)"><rect x="6" y="${(45 - topH).toFixed(1)}" width="48" height="${topH.toFixed(1)}" fill="url(#hgS)"/>
        <rect x="6" y="${botY.toFixed(1)}" width="48" height="${botH.toFixed(1)}" fill="url(#hgS)"/></g>
      ${run ? `<line class="hg-st" x1="30" x2="30" y1="45" y2="${botY.toFixed(1)}" stroke="#ffd84a" stroke-width="1.6"/>` +
        [0, .35, .7].map(dl => `<circle class="hg-gr" cx="30" cy="46" r="1.4" fill="#fff" style="--d:${(botY - 46).toFixed(1)}px;animation-delay:${dl}s"/>`).join('') : ''}
      <path d="${glass}" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>`;
    $('dbWaktu').innerHTML = `<div class="db-wrap"><div class="db-hg">${hg}</div><div class="db-wc"><div class="db-w">
      <div>Mulai proyek<b>${fm(MULAI)}</b></div>
      <div>Sudah berjalan<b>${jl}${jalan < 0 ? '' : ' hari'}</b>dari ${total} hari</div>
      <div>Batas waktu<b>${fm(BATAS)}</b></div>
      <div>Sisa waktu<b>${sl} hari</b>${sisa < 0 ? 'melewati batas waktu' : 'menuju batas waktu'}</div></div>
      <div class="db-wb" role="img" aria-label="Waktu terpakai ${nf.format(WP)} persen"><i style="width:${WP.toFixed(1)}%"></i></div>
      <div class="db-wl">Waktu proyek terpakai ${nf.format(WP)}%</div></div></div>`;
  }

  function units(u, tr) {
    if (!u || !u.length) return '';
    return '<div class="db-units"><div class="db-ut">Per unit \u2022 target rental ' + nf.format(tr) + ' jam</div>' + u.map(x => {
      const pc = x.jam / tr * 100;
      return `<div><div class="db-un"><span class="nm">${esc(x.kode)} \u2022 ${esc(x.nama)}</span><span class="stp ${esc(x.status)}">${esc(x.status || 'Belum lapor')}</span></div>` +
        `<div class="db-ub"><i style="width:${Math.min(100, pc).toFixed(1)}%"></i></div>` +
        `<div class="db-ui"><b class="db-pct">${nf.format(pc)}%</b> \u2022 ${nf.format(x.jam)} / ${nf.format(tr)} jam \u2022 ${pc >= 100 ? 'target tercapai' : 'sisa ' + nf.format(tr - x.jam) + ' jam'} \u2022 ${nf.format(x.bbm)} L BBM</div></div>`;
    }).join('') + '</div>';
  }

  function cmp(h) {
    const S = [{ k: 'jam', n: 'Jam kerja', c: '#1e90ff', u: 'jam' }, { k: 'gal', n: 'Hasil galian', c: '#1f9d55', u: 'm\u00b3' }, { k: 'bbm', n: 'BBM', c: '#f5c400', u: 'L' }];
    const mx = {}, tot = {}; S.forEach(x => { mx[x.k] = Math.max(0, ...h.map(d => d[x.k])); tot[x.k] = h.reduce((t, d) => t + d[x.k], 0); });
    $('dbCmpL').innerHTML = S.map(x => `<span><i style="background:${x.c}"></i>${x.n} (puncak ${nf.format(mx[x.k])} ${x.u})</span>`).join('');
    const J = tot.jam, B = tot.bbm, G = tot.gal;
    $('dbCmpK').innerHTML = `<div><b>${nf.format(J)} jam</b>Jam kerja</div><div><b>${nf.format(B)} L</b>BBM</div><div><b>${nf.format(G)} m\u00b3</b>Hasil galian</div><div><b>${G > 0 ? nf.format(B / G) : '-'} L/m\u00b3</b>BBM per m\u00b3 galian</div><div><b>${J > 0 && G > 0 ? nf.format(G / J) : '-'} m\u00b3/jam</b>Galian per jam kerja</div>`;
    if (!S.some(x => mx[x.k] > 0)) { $('dbCmp').innerHTML = '<div class="empty">Belum ada data pada rentang ini.</div>'; return; }
    const W = 700, H = 270, L = 42, R = 14, T = 46, B2 = 28, iw = W - L - R, ih = H - T - B2, n = h.length, bw = iw / n;
    const cx = i => L + i * bw + bw / 2, Y = v => T + ih - v / 100 * ih, pct = (d, k) => mx[k] ? d[k] / mx[k] * 100 : 0;
    let g = '';
    for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) { const y = Y(i * 25); g += `<line x1="${L}" x2="${W - R}" y1="${y}" y2="${y}" stroke="#dbe6f6"/><text x="${L - 6}" y="${y + 4}" text-anchor="end">${i * 25}%</text>`; }
    const gw = Math.min(50, bw * .72), one = gw / 2 - 1;
    const bars = h.map((d, i) => [['jam', 'url(#cmpB)', 0], ['gal', 'url(#cmpG)', 1]].map(q => {
      const v = d[q[0]]; if (!(v > 0)) return '';
      const x = cx(i) - gw / 2 + q[2] * (one + 2), y = Y(pct(d, q[0]));
      return `<rect x="${x.toFixed(1)}" y="${y.toFixed(1)}" width="${one.toFixed(1)}" height="${(T + ih - y).toFixed(1)}" rx="3" fill="${q[1]}"><title>${tgl(d.tanggal)} \u2022 ${q[0] === 'jam' ? 'Jam kerja' : 'Hasil galian'}: ${nf.format(v)} ${q[0] === 'jam' ? 'jam' : 'm\u00b3'}</title></rect>`;
    }).join('')).join('');
    let line = '';
    if (mx.bbm > 0) {
      const pt = h.map((d, i) => [cx(i), Y(pct(d, 'bbm'))]);
      let dd = 'M' + pt[0][0].toFixed(1) + ' ' + pt[0][1].toFixed(1);
      for (let i = 0; i < pt.length - 1; i++) {
        const p0 = pt[i - 1] || pt[i], p1 = pt[i], p2 = pt[i + 1], p3 = pt[i + 2] || p2;
        dd += `C${(p1[0] + (p2[0] - p0[0]) / 6).toFixed(1)} ${(p1[1] + (p2[1] - p0[1]) / 6).toFixed(1)} ${(p2[0] - (p3[0] - p1[0]) / 6).toFixed(1)} ${(p2[1] - (p3[1] - p1[1]) / 6).toFixed(1)} ${p2[0].toFixed(1)} ${p2[1].toFixed(1)}`;
      }
      const area = dd + `L${pt[n - 1][0].toFixed(1)} ${T + ih}L${pt[0][0].toFixed(1)} ${T + ih}Z`;
      const pk = h.reduce((m, d, i) => d.bbm > h[m].bbm ? i : m, 0), pp = pt[pk];
      line = `<path d="${area}" fill="url(#cmpA)"/><path d="${dd}" fill="none" stroke="#f5c400" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>` +
        pt.map((q, i) => `<circle cx="${q[0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${q[1].toFixed(1)}" r="5.5" fill="#f5c400" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2"><title>${tgl(h[i].tanggal)} \u2022 BBM: ${nf.format(h[i].bbm)} L</title></circle>`).join('') +
        `<rect x="${(pp[0] - 36).toFixed(1)}" y="${(pp[1] - 40).toFixed(1)}" width="72" height="26" rx="6" fill="#123d6b"/><path d="M${(pp[0] - 6).toFixed(1)} ${(pp[1] - 14).toFixed(1)}l6 8 6-8z" fill="#123d6b"/><text class="cl" x="${pp[0].toFixed(1)}" y="${(pp[1] - 22).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="middle">${nf.format(h[pk].bbm)} L</text>`;
    }
    const ev = Math.ceil(n / 7);
    const xl = h.map((d, i) => (i % ev === 0 || i === n - 1) ? `<text x="${cx(i).toFixed(1)}" y="${H - 8}" text-anchor="middle">${tgl(d.tanggal)}</text>` : '').join('');
    $('dbCmp').innerHTML = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" role="img" aria-label="Perbandingan jam kerja, hasil galian, dan BBM harian" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible">
      <defs><linearGradient id="cmpB" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#1e90ff" stop-opacity=".95"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8fc8ff" stop-opacity=".55"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="cmpG" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#1f9d55" stop-opacity=".95"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8fdcb0" stop-opacity=".55"/></linearGradient>
      <linearGradient id="cmpA" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f5c400" stop-opacity=".4"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f5c400" stop-opacity=".04"/></linearGradient></defs>
      ${g}${bars}${line}${xl}</svg>`;
  }

  function render(p) {
    const a = p.alat, pc = n => a.total ? n / a.total * 100 : 0;
    $('dbTgl').textContent = new Date().toLocaleDateString('id-ID', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });
    const kc = (c, ic, t, v, line, pct, lbl, ex) => `<div class="db-k ${c}"><div class="db-ic">${ic}</div><span>${t}</span><b>${v}</b><span class="db-sub">${line}</span><div class="db-pb"><i style="width:${Math.min(100, pct).toFixed(1)}%"></i></div><small>${lbl}</small>${ex || ''}</div>`;
    const T = p.total, Pg = p.progres, TP = T.prod, n = nf.format;
    const tr = p.targetRental || 200, rp = p.unit.length ? Math.min(100, T.jam / (tr * p.unit.length) * 100) : 0;
    $('dbK1').innerHTML = kc('t', '\u{1F69C}', 'Pemakaian alat', n(T.jam) + '<em>jam</em>', 'BBM ' + n(T.bbm) + ' L \u2022 Hari ini ' + a.ber + ' / ' + a.total + ' beroperasi', rp, n(rp) + '% dari target rental ' + n(tr * p.unit.length) + ' jam (' + p.unit.length + ' unit \u00d7 ' + n(tr) + ' jam)', units(p.unit, tr));
    $('dbK').innerHTML =
      kc('s', '\u{1F69A}', 'Langsir galian (DT)', n(Pg.langsir.real) + '<em>m\u00b3</em>', 'Total ' + n(T.rit) + ' rit \u2022 sisa ' + n(Pg.langsir.sisa) + ' m\u00b3', Pg.langsir.capai, n(Pg.langsir.capai) + '% dari target ' + n(Pg.langsir.target) + ' m\u00b3') +
      kc('o', '\u26CF', 'Hasil galian', n(Pg.galian.real) + '<em>m\u00b3</em>', 'Sisa ' + n(Pg.galian.sisa) + ' m\u00b3' + (Pg.galian.estHari ? ' \u2022 selesai \u00b1' + n(Pg.galian.estHari) + ' hari kerja' : ''), Pg.galian.capai, n(Pg.galian.capai) + '% dari target ' + n(Pg.galian.target) + ' m\u00b3') +
      kc('p', '\u{1F4C8}', 'Produktivitas', n(TP.util) + '<em>%</em>', (TP.prodDT ? 'DT ' + n(TP.prodDT) + ' m\u00b3/jam' : 'DT belum ada data') + (TP.lM3 ? ' \u2022 ' + n(TP.lM3) + ' L/m\u00b3' : ''), TP.util, 'Utilisasi rata-rata keseluruhan');

    const msgs = [], g = p.galian, pr = p.prod.ringkas;
    msgs.push(`Galian hari ini <b>${nf.format(g.volHari)}</b> dari target <b>${nf.format(g.target)} m\u00b3</b> (${nf.format(g.capai)}%).`);
    if (a.rsk) msgs.push(`<b>${a.rsk}</b> alat berstatus rusak, cek kendala di Laporan Harian.`);
    if (a.belum) msgs.push(`${a.belum} alat belum dilaporkan hari ini.`);
    waktu(); msgs.push(`Waktu proyek terpakai ${nf.format(WP)}%, progres galian ${nf.format(p.progres.galian.capai)}% dari target.`);
    $('dbInfo').innerHTML = msgs.join(' ');

    const h = p.harian, tot = h.reduce((t, x) => t + x.bbm, 0), ak = h.filter(x => x.bbm > 0).length;
    const top = h.reduce((m, x) => x.bbm > m.bbm ? x : m, h[0]);
    $('dbBbmK').innerHTML = `<div><b>${nf.format(tot)} L</b>Total ${p.days} hari</div><div><b>${nf.format(ak ? tot / ak : 0)} L</b>Rata-rata per hari kerja</div><div><b>${top.bbm ? nf.format(top.bbm) + ' L' : '-'}</b>Tertinggi${top.bbm ? ' (' + tgl(top.tanggal) + ')' : ''}</div>`;
    chart('dbBbm', h, 'bbm', '#1e63c8');
    cmp(h);

    $('dbStatus').innerHTML = donut([{ v: a.ber, c: '#1f7a45' }, { v: a.sby, c: '#f5c400' }, { v: a.rsk, c: '#b3261e' }, { v: a.belum, c: '#c9cdd1' }], a.total, 'Unit') +
      `<div class="db-leg"><div><i style="background:#1f7a45"></i>Beroperasi: ${a.ber} (${nf.format(pc(a.ber))}%)</div><div><i style="background:#f5c400"></i>Standby: ${a.sby} (${nf.format(pc(a.sby))}%)</div><div><i style="background:#b3261e"></i>Breakdown: ${a.rsk} (${nf.format(pc(a.rsk))}%)</div><div><i style="background:#c9cdd1"></i>Belum lapor: ${a.belum}</div></div>`;
    $('dbEf').textContent = nf.format(pr.util) + '%';

    chart('dbGal', h, 'gal', '#1f9d55', g.target);
    chart('dbLang', h, 'lang', '#f08a00');
    $('dbPg').innerHTML = progHtml('Total galian', p.progres.galian);
    $('dbPl').innerHTML = progHtml('Total langsiran', p.progres.langsir);
    renderCapai('dbExc', g.exc);

    const L = p.langsir;
    $('dbL').innerHTML = [[nf.format(L.ritHari), 'Rit hari ini'], [nf.format(L.volHari) + ' m\u00b3', 'Volume hari ini']].map(x => `<div class="stat"><b>${x[0]}</b><span>${x[1]}</span></div>`).join('');
    renderBars('dbDT', L.perDT, 'vol', 'lang', 'm\u00b3', 'n');
    renderBars('dbRute', L.rute, 'vol', 'lang', 'm\u00b3', 'n');

    $('dbProd').innerHTML = donut([{ v: pr.util, c: '#7b3fe0' }, { v: Math.max(0, 100 - pr.util), c: '#eef0f1' }], nf.format(pr.util) + '%', 'Utilisasi') +
      `<div class="db-leg"><div><b>${pr.prodDT ? nf.format(pr.prodDT) + ' m\u00b3/jam' : '-'}</b><br>Produktivitas rata-rata DT</div><div><b>${nf.format(pr.vol)} m\u00b3</b><br>Material dipindah (${nf.format(pr.rit)} rit)</div><div><b>${pr.lM3 ? nf.format(pr.lM3) + ' L/m\u00b3' : '-'}</b><br>BBM per m\u00b3 material</div></div>`;
    renderBars('dbTop', p.prod.top, 'util', 'prod', '%');

    $('dbAkt').innerHTML = p.aktivitas.length
      ? '<tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Alat</th><th>Operator</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Jam</th><th>Status</th></tr>' +
        p.aktivitas.map(l => `<tr><td>${esc(l.tanggal)}</td><td>${esc(l.kode)}</td><td>${esc(l.operator)}</td><td>${esc(l.lokasi) || '-'}</td><td>${nf.format(l.jam)}</td><td><span class="b ${esc(l.status)}">${esc(l.status)}</span></td></tr>`).join('')
      : '<tr><td>Belum ada aktivitas tercatat.</td></tr>';
  }

  waktu();
  btn.click(); // Ringkasan jadi halaman awal
})();
</script>
